cr503.verifiedText: Whenever a pleading or other paper is served under Rules 5.01 and 5.02, proof of the time and manner of service is filed before court or party action. Proof may be a certificate of a member of the bar, an affidavit of the person who served the papers, or other proof satisfactory to the court. The certificate or affidavit identifies by name the persons served. Electronic proof states the electronic notification address and that the document was served electronically.
cr503.limitation: The official order confirms the rule wording but is not a 2026 codification. Recheck current rule text and any controlling local procedure before implementation/adoption is finalized.

cr501.useInBoundedCorrection: Retain the obligation to prove service of papers served under CR 5.01/5.02; do not infer an extra document, recipient, deadline, or method.

cr502.officialCrossCheck: The same 2010-09 official order states service on the attorney for a represented party unless the court orders service on the party; it describes delivery, mailing to the last known address, leaving with the clerk when no address is known, and electronic service only with written consent and an electronic notification address.
cr502.useInBoundedCorrection: Retain applicable recipient/method controls; do not guess recipients, expose protected addresses, or import a criminal-route prosecutor certificate into this civil protective-order route.
